描述_EN: fragment of the upper half of a polychrome tapestry square. the square is framed by a double border, the widest around the central square, composed of a highly stylized acanthus leaf frieze, and the second, on the outside of the fragment, forming a frieze of posts. a two-row green necklace can be seen around her neck. a female bust in a medallion set in a square occupies the center of the composition. the woman, with large black-rimmed eyes and long brown hair, wears long earrings, consisting of two white balls, surviving only today on the left ear.
描述_ZN: 多色挂毯方形上半部分的碎片。 该广场被一个双边框所包围，最宽的边框围绕着中央广场，由一个高度风格化的刺桐叶楣组成，第二个边框在碎片的外面，形成一个柱子的楣。 可以看出她脖子上有一条绿色的两排项链。 一个镶嵌在广场上的女性半身雕像占据了构图的中心。 这个女人，有一双黑框大眼睛，棕色长发，戴着长长的耳环，由两个白球组成，如今只存于左耳上。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期；伊斯兰统治时期
